speaker: Rajesh
text: More importantly, you've adopted a voice changer? Oh, I call dibs on the Golden Age Flash.

speaker: Howard
text: Hang on, I need that to complete my Justice Society of America collection. You can't just call dibs.

speaker: Rajesh
text: Too bad, I call dibs. I can, I did look up dibs on Wikipedia.

speaker: Howard
text: Dibs doesn't apply in a bidding war.

speaker: Leonard
text: Not for long. It's not a bidding war. I'm selling it all to Larry down at the comic book store.

speaker: Rajesh
text: Why Larry? Did Larry call dibs?

speaker: Leonard
text: He offered me a fair price for the whole collection.

speaker: Howard
text: What's the number? I'll match it.

speaker: Rajesh
text: I'll match it plus a thousand rupees.

speaker: Howard
text: What's the exchange rate? None of your business. Mom, my bar mitzvah bonds. How much do I got? Thanks. I can go twenty six hundred dollars and two trees in Israel.

speaker: Leonard
text: Forget it, guys. If I sell to one of you, the other two are gonna be really mad at me.

speaker: Howard
text: Who cares as long as you pick me?

speaker: Rajesh
text: Okay, Leonard, put down the box. Let's talk.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sorry, Raj. My mind is made up.

speaker: Howard
text: No, I can't let you do this.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, get out of my way.
